SELECT 
    key AS stock_symbol, 
    (time_map->>key)::timestamp::date AS date_value,

    cp.market_cap
FROM generic_data gd,

  ROUND(COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'ShareholdingOfPromoterAndPromoterGroup' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0), 2) AS promoter_shareholding_percentage,
  ROUND(COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'PublicShareholding' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0), 2) AS public_shareholding_percentage,

  ROUND((COALESCE((shareholding_pattern::json ->> 'NumberOfShares')::numeric, 0) / 10000000), 2) AS number_of_shares_in_crore,
  COALESCE((shareholding_pattern::json ->> 'NumberOfShareholders')::numeric, 0) AS number_of_shareholders,

  ROUND(
    (
      COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'ShareholdingOfPromoterAndPromoterGroup' -> 'Indian' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0) +
      COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'ShareholdingOfPromoterAndPromoterGroup' -> 'Foreign' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0) +
      COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'PublicShareholding' -> 'InstitutionsDomestic' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0) +
      COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'PublicShareholding' -> 'InstitutionsForeign' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0) +
      COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'PublicShareholding' -> 'Goverments' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0) +
      COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'PublicShareholding' -> 'NonInstitutions' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0) +
      COALESCE((axis_summaries::json -> 'SharesHeldByNonPromoterNonPublicShareholders' -> 'SharesHeldByNonPromoterNonPublicShareholders' -> 'aggregates' ->> 'ShareholdingAsAPercentageOfTotalNumberOfShares')::numeric, 0)
    ),

WITH generic_symbols AS (
  SELECT json_data.key AS stock_symbol
  FROM generic_data gd
  JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(gd.time_map) AS json_data(key, value) ON true
),
filtered_data AS (
  SELECT ss.*
  FROM shareholder_summaries ss
  INNER JOIN generic_symbols gs ON ss.stock_symbol = gs.stock_symbol
),
ordered_data AS (
  SELECT
    fd.stock_symbol,
    fd.to_date,
    (fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfShares')::BIGINT AS number_of_shares,
    fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfSharesOriginal' AS number_of_shares_original,
    LAG((fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfShares')::BIGINT) OVER (
      PARTITION BY fd.stock_symbol
      ORDER BY fd.to_date DESC
    ) AS prev_number_of_shares
  FROM filtered_data fd
),
with_percent_increase AS (
  SELECT
    stock_symbol,
    to_date,
    number_of_shares,
    number_of_shares_original,
    prev_number_of_shares,
    ROUND((number_of_shares - prev_number_of_shares) * 100.0 / prev_number_of_shares, 2) AS shares_percent_increase
  FROM ordered_data
  WHERE prev_number_of_shares IS NOT NULL
    AND prev_number_of_shares > 0
)
SELECT
  wpi.stock_symbol,
  cp.company_type, 
  wpi.to_date,
  wpi.number_of_shares,
  wpi.number_of_shares_original,
  wpi.prev_number_of_shares,
  wpi.shares_percent_increase,
  sbu.corp_action,
  sbu.numerator,
  sbu.denominator,
  sbu.ex_date,
  sbu.ex_date_override,
  sbu.comments,
  cp.market_cap,

  CASE
    WHEN sbu.corp_action IN ('Bonus', 'Rights') AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
      ROUND(1 + sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
    WHEN sbu.corp_action = 'Split' AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
      ROUND(sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS multiplier,

  ROUND(wpi.number_of_shares::NUMERIC / NULLIF(wpi.prev_number_of_shares, 0), 4) AS share_ratio,
  ROUND(wpi.prev_number_of_shares::NUMERIC / NULLIF(wpi.number_of_shares, 0), 4) AS rev_share_ratio,

  CASE
    WHEN ROUND(wpi.number_of_shares::NUMERIC / NULLIF(wpi.prev_number_of_shares, 0), 4) =
         CASE
           WHEN sbu.corp_action IN ('Bonus', 'Rights') AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
             ROUND(1 + sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
           WHEN sbu.corp_action = 'Split' AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
             ROUND(sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
           ELSE NULL
         END THEN 'TRUE'
    ELSE ''
  END AS check_1,

  CASE
    WHEN ROUND(wpi.prev_number_of_shares::NUMERIC / NULLIF(wpi.number_of_shares, 0), 4) =
         CASE
           WHEN sbu.corp_action IN ('Bonus', 'Rights') AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
             ROUND(1 + sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
           WHEN sbu.corp_action = 'Split' AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
             ROUND(sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
           ELSE NULL
         END THEN 'TRUE'
    ELSE ''
  END AS check_2,

  DATE_PART('year', wpi.to_date) * 12 + DATE_PART('month', wpi.to_date) -
  (DATE_PART('year', sbu.ex_date) * 12 + DATE_PART('month', sbu.ex_date)) AS month_diff,

  CASE
    WHEN wpi.shares_percent_increase > 0 THEN 'Increase'
    WHEN wpi.shares_percent_increase < 0 THEN 'Decrease'
    ELSE 'No Change'
  END AS change_direction

FROM with_percent_increase wpi
LEFT JOIN utils.split_bonus_utils sbu ON wpi.stock_symbol = sbu.stock_symbol
LEFT JOIN company_profiles cp ON wpi.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol
WHERE ABS(wpi.shares_percent_increase) > 25
  AND cp.company_name NOT ILIKE '%Mutual Fund%'   -- ✅ Added condition
  AND cp.company_type in ('equity','SME')
  AND (sbu.comments = '' or sbu.comments is null or sbu.comments = 'Automated override')
ORDER BY wpi.shares_percent_increase DESC;

rule_desc: Stock symbols that are in share_ownerships but not in share_ownership_histories, and vice versa.
template:
SELECT DISTINCT
    soh.stock_symbol,
	soh.date_header,
    'Missing in share_ownerships' AS missing_from,
    cp.market_cap
FROM share_ownership_histories soh
LEFT JOIN company_profiles cp
    ON cp.stock_symbol = soh.stock_symbol
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM share_ownerships so
    WHERE so.stock_symbol = soh.stock_symbol
)

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT
    so.stock_symbol,
	so.date_header, 
    'Missing in share_ownership_histories' AS missing_from,
    cp.market_cap
FROM share_ownerships so
LEFT JOIN company_profiles cp
    ON cp.stock_symbol = so.stock_symbol
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM share_ownership_histories soh
    WHERE soh.stock_symbol = so.stock_symbol
)

ORDER BY missing_from, stock_symbol;

rule_desc: Company present in Company_profiles but missing in share_ownership_histories or share_ownerships.
template:
SELECT
    cp.stock_symbol,
    cp.market_cap,
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM share_ownerships so
            WHERE so.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM share_ownership_histories soh
            WHERE soh.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol
        )
            THEN 'Missing in both'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM share_ownerships so
            WHERE so.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol
        )
            THEN 'Missing in share_ownerships'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM share_ownership_histories soh
            WHERE soh.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol
        )
            THEN 'Missing in share_ownership_histories'
    END AS missing_status
FROM company_profiles cp
WHERE
    cp.active = true
    AND (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM share_ownerships so
            WHERE so.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol
        )
        OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM share_ownership_histories soh
            WHERE soh.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    cp.market_cap DESC;

rule_desc: This SQL identifies records in shareholder_summaries where key data fields in shareholding_pattern, axis_summaries, declaration, or summaries are missing or empty.
template:
SELECT 
    stock_symbol, 
    date_header, 
    shareholding_pattern,
    axis_summaries,
    declaration,
    summaries,
    -- Identify the first missing key field from shareholding_pattern
    CASE 
        WHEN shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' IS NULL OR shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' = '' THEN 'NumberOfShares' 
        WHEN shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShareholders' IS NULL OR shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShareholders' = '' THEN 'NumberOfShareholders' 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS missing_field
FROM shareholder_summaries
WHERE 
    -- Conditions to detect missing values in shareholding_pattern
    shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' IS NULL OR shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' = ''
    OR shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShareholders' IS NULL OR shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShareholders' = ''
    -- Conditions to check if axis_summaries, declaration, or summaries are null or empty

    SELECT

    FROM shareholder_summaries
    GROUP BY stock_symbol
),
years AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_symbol,

    CROSS JOIN (

),
missing AS (

rule_desc:
High % increase in shares across the year. 
This is for each year.
template:
WITH MarData AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_symbol, 
        date_header, 
        (shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfShares')::NUMERIC / 10000000 AS shares_in_crore
    FROM 
        shareholder_summaries
    WHERE 
        date_header LIKE 'Mar %'
),
RankedMarData AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_symbol, 
        date_header, 
        shares_in_crore,
        LAG(shares_in_crore) OVER (PARTITION BY stock_symbol ORDER BY date_header ASC) AS prev_shares,
        LAG(date_header) OVER (PARTITION BY stock_symbol ORDER BY date_header ASC) AS prev_date_header
    FROM 
        MarData
),
FilteredData AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_symbol, 
        jsonb_build_object(
            'current_date_header', date_header,
            'prev_date_header', prev_date_header,
            'current_shares_crore', ROUND(shares_in_crore, 2),
            'previous_shares_crore', ROUND(prev_shares, 2),
            'percent_increase', ROUND(((shares_in_crore - prev_shares) / prev_shares) * 100, 2)
        ) AS quarter_data
    FROM 
        RankedMarData
    WHERE 
        prev_shares IS NOT NULL
        AND ((shares_in_crore - prev_shares) / prev_shares) * 100 > 5
),
AggregatedData AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_symbol, 
        jsonb_agg(quarter_data) AS yearly_details
    FROM 
        FilteredData
    GROUP BY 
        stock_symbol
),
ExtractedSymbols AS (
    SELECT 
        jsonb_object_keys(time_map) AS stock_symbol, 
        (time_map ->> jsonb_object_keys(time_map))::TEXT AS timestamp
    FROM 
        generic_data
)
SELECT 
    a.stock_symbol, 
    a.yearly_details, 
    e.timestamp AS stock_timestamp
FROM 
    AggregatedData a
JOIN 
    ExtractedSymbols e ON a.stock_symbol = e.stock_symbol;

rule_desc:
Analysis SQL

EPS Calculated using Profit / NumberOfShares
template:
SELECT
    pl.stock_symbol,
    pl.date_header,
    pl.period,

    -- Converted to crore
    ROUND(CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 10000000, 2) AS standalone_PL_crore,
    ROUND(CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 10000000, 2) AS consolidated_PL_crore,

    -- Round CalculatedEPS to 2 decimals
    ROUND(CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'CalculatedEPS' AS NUMERIC), 2) AS standalone_CalculatedEPS,
    ROUND(CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'AdjustedEPS' AS NUMERIC), 2) AS standalone_AdjustedEPS,
    ROUND(CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'AdjustedDilutedEPS' AS NUMERIC), 2) AS standalone_AdjustedDilutedEPS,
    ROUND(CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'CalculatedEPS' AS NUMERIC), 2) AS consolidated_CalculatedEPS,
    ROUND(CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'AdjustedEPS' AS NUMERIC), 2) AS consolidated_AdjustedEPS,
    ROUND(CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'AdjustedDilutedEPS' AS NUMERIC), 2) AS consolidated_AdjustedDilutedEPS,

    -- EPS Computed using Profit / NumberOfShares
    ROUND(
        CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 
        NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0), 
    2) AS standalone_EPS_Computed,

    ROUND(
        CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 
        NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0), 
    2) AS consolidated_EPS_Computed,

    -- NumberOfShares used in EPS Computation
    NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0) AS number_of_shares_used,

    -- % Difference: standalone_CalculatedEPS vs standalone_AdjustedDilutedEPS
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'AdjustedDilutedEPS' AS NUMERIC) != 0 THEN
            ROUND((
                (CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'CalculatedEPS' AS NUMERIC) - CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'AdjustedDilutedEPS' AS NUMERIC)) /
                CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'AdjustedDilutedEPS' AS NUMERIC)
            ) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS standalone_EPS_pct_diff,

    -- % Difference: consolidated_CalculatedEPS vs consolidated_AdjustedDilutedEPS
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'AdjustedDilutedEPS' AS NUMERIC) != 0 THEN
            ROUND((
                (CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'CalculatedEPS' AS NUMERIC) - CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'AdjustedDilutedEPS' AS NUMERIC)) /
                CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'AdjustedDilutedEPS' AS NUMERIC)
            ) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS consolidated_EPS_pct_diff,

    -- % Difference: standalone_CalculatedEPS vs standalone_EPS_Computed
    CASE 
        WHEN 
            ROUND(
                CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 
                NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0), 2
            ) != 0
        THEN ROUND((
            (CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'CalculatedEPS' AS NUMERIC) - 
             ROUND(CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 
                   NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0), 2))
            / ROUND(CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 
                   NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0), 2)
        ) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS standalone_Calc_vs_Computed_pct_diff,

    -- % Difference: consolidated_CalculatedEPS vs consolidated_EPS_Computed
    CASE 
        WHEN 
            ROUND(
                CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 
                NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0), 2
            ) != 0
        THEN ROUND((
            (CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'CalculatedEPS' AS NUMERIC) - 
             ROUND(CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 
                   NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0), 2))
            / ROUND(CAST(pl.consolidated_json->>'ProfitLossForPeriodForEPS' AS NUMERIC) / 
                   NULLIF(CAST(ss.shareholding_pattern->>'NumberOfShares' AS NUMERIC), 0), 2)
        ) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS consolidated_Calc_vs_Computed_pct_diff,

    -- Match or Do not match based on difference less than 5%
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'AdjustedEPS' AS NUMERIC) = 0 THEN 'Do not match'
        WHEN ABS(
            (CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'CalculatedEPS' AS NUMERIC) - CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'AdjustedEPS' AS NUMERIC))
            / CAST(pl.standalone_json->>'AdjustedEPS' AS NUMERIC)
            ) < 0.05 THEN 'Match'
        ELSE 'Do not match'
    END AS standalone_EPS_match_status,

    -- Corporate action check
    CASE 
        WHEN sbu.stock_symbol IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS corporate_action,

    -- Market cap from company_profiles
    cp.market_cap,

    -- Exclude_quarter flag
    CASE
        WHEN
            LENGTH(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pl.date_header, ' ', 2))) = 4
            AND SPLIT_PART(pl.date_header, ' ', 2) ~ '^\d{4}$'
            AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(pl.date_header, ' ', 2) AS INTEGER) <= 2023
            AND LOWER(pl.period) LIKE '%quarterly%'
        THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Exclude_quarter

FROM
    profit_losses pl
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT stock_symbol FROM utils.split_bonus_utils
) sbu ON pl.stock_symbol = sbu.stock_symbol

LEFT JOIN shareholder_summaries ss
    ON pl.stock_symbol = ss.stock_symbol
    AND pl.date_header = ss.date_header

LEFT JOIN company_profiles cp
    ON pl.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol

WHERE
    (pl.standalone_json->>'CalculatedEPS') IS NOT NULL
    OR (pl.consolidated_json->>'CalculatedEPS') IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY
    pl.timestamp DESC;

rule_desc:
SQl to identify where bonus or split is not applied.
Joined with generic data table.
template:
WITH generic_symbols AS (
  SELECT  
    json_data.key AS stock_symbol
  FROM generic_data gd,
       LATERAL jsonb_each_text(gd.time_map) AS json_data(key, value)
),
filtered_symbols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT stock_symbol
  FROM utils.split_bonus_utils
  WHERE stock_symbol IN (SELECT stock_symbol FROM generic_symbols)
),
filtered_data AS (
  SELECT ss.* 
  FROM shareholder_summaries ss
  INNER JOIN filtered_symbols fs ON ss.stock_symbol = fs.stock_symbol
),
ordered_data AS (
  SELECT
    fd.stock_symbol,
    fd.to_date,
    (fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfShares')::BIGINT AS number_of_shares,
    fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfSharesOriginal' AS number_of_shares_original,
    LAG((fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfShares')::BIGINT) OVER (
      PARTITION BY fd.stock_symbol
      ORDER BY fd.to_date DESC
    ) AS prev_number_of_shares
  FROM filtered_data fd
),
all_combinations AS (
  SELECT
    od.stock_symbol,
    od.to_date,
    od.number_of_shares,
    od.number_of_shares_original,
    od.prev_number_of_shares,
    sbu.ex_date,
    sbu.corp_action,
    sbu.numerator,
    sbu.denominator,
    sbu.comments  -- Added the comments field here
  FROM ordered_data od
  CROSS JOIN utils.split_bonus_utils sbu
  WHERE od.stock_symbol = sbu.stock_symbol
    AND od.prev_number_of_shares IS NOT NULL
    AND od.to_date > sbu.ex_date
    AND (
      DATE_PART('year', AGE(od.to_date, sbu.ex_date)) * 12 + 
      DATE_PART('month', AGE(od.to_date, sbu.ex_date))
    ) <= 4  -- Only include if difference is within 4 months
),
ratio_calc AS (
  SELECT
    ac.stock_symbol,
    ac.to_date,
    ac.ex_date,
    ac.number_of_shares,
    ac.number_of_shares_original,
    ac.prev_number_of_shares,
    ac.corp_action,
    ac.numerator,
    ac.denominator,
    ac.comments,  -- Added comments here as well
    CASE 
      WHEN ac.number_of_shares <> 0 
      THEN ROUND(CAST(ac.prev_number_of_shares AS NUMERIC) / ac.number_of_shares, 4)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ratio,
    DATE_PART('year', AGE(ac.to_date, ac.ex_date)) * 12 + DATE_PART('month', AGE(ac.to_date, ac.ex_date)) AS months_diff,
    CASE
      WHEN ac.corp_action = 'Bonus' OR ac.corp_action = 'Rights' THEN ROUND(1 + CAST(ac.numerator AS NUMERIC) / ac.denominator, 4)
      WHEN ac.corp_action = 'Split' THEN ROUND(CAST(ac.numerator AS NUMERIC) / ac.denominator, 4)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS multiplier
  FROM all_combinations ac
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT * ,
         ROUND(ABS(ratio - multiplier) / multiplier * 100, 2) AS percent_diff,
         ROUND(ABS(prev_number_of_shares - number_of_shares) * 100.0 / number_of_shares, 2) AS shares_percent_diff
  FROM ratio_calc
)
SELECT 
    stock_symbol,
    to_date,
    ex_date,
    corp_action,
    number_of_shares,
    number_of_shares_original,
    prev_number_of_shares,
    ratio,
    multiplier,
    percent_diff,
    months_diff,
    comments  -- Finally selecting the comments field
FROM final_result
WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND multiplier IS NOT NULL
  AND ratio <> 1
  AND percent_diff <= 10
ORDER BY stock_symbol, to_date DESC, ex_date DESC;

rule_desc: Joined with generic data table and get % increase for each row.
template:
WITH generic_symbols AS (
  SELECT json_data.key AS stock_symbol
  FROM generic_data gd
  JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(gd.time_map) AS json_data(key, value) ON true
),
filtered_data AS (
  SELECT ss.*
  FROM shareholder_summaries ss
  INNER JOIN generic_symbols gs ON ss.stock_symbol = gs.stock_symbol
),
ordered_data AS (
  SELECT
    fd.stock_symbol,
    fd.to_date,
    (fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfShares')::BIGINT AS number_of_shares,
    fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfSharesOriginal' AS number_of_shares_original,
    LAG((fd.shareholding_pattern ->> 'NumberOfShares')::BIGINT) OVER (
      PARTITION BY fd.stock_symbol
      ORDER BY fd.to_date DESC
    ) AS prev_number_of_shares
  FROM filtered_data fd
),
with_percent_increase AS (
  SELECT
    stock_symbol,
    to_date,
    number_of_shares,
    number_of_shares_original,
    prev_number_of_shares,
    ROUND((number_of_shares - prev_number_of_shares) * 100.0 / prev_number_of_shares, 2) AS shares_percent_increase
  FROM ordered_data
  WHERE prev_number_of_shares IS NOT NULL
    AND prev_number_of_shares > 0
)
SELECT
  wpi.stock_symbol,
  wpi.to_date,
  wpi.number_of_shares,
  wpi.number_of_shares_original,
  wpi.prev_number_of_shares,
  wpi.shares_percent_increase,
  sbu.corp_action,
  sbu.numerator,
  sbu.denominator,
  sbu.ex_date,
  sbu.ex_date_override,
  sbu.comments,
  cp.market_cap,

  -- Calculate multiplier
  CASE
    WHEN sbu.corp_action IN ('Bonus', 'Rights') AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
      ROUND(1 + sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
    WHEN sbu.corp_action = 'Split' AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
      ROUND(sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS multiplier,

  -- Share ratios
  ROUND(wpi.number_of_shares::NUMERIC / NULLIF(wpi.prev_number_of_shares, 0), 4) AS share_ratio,
  ROUND(wpi.prev_number_of_shares::NUMERIC / NULLIF(wpi.number_of_shares, 0), 4) AS rev_share_ratio,

  -- Check conditions
  CASE
    WHEN ROUND(wpi.number_of_shares::NUMERIC / NULLIF(wpi.prev_number_of_shares, 0), 4) =
         CASE
           WHEN sbu.corp_action IN ('Bonus', 'Rights') AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
             ROUND(1 + sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
           WHEN sbu.corp_action = 'Split' AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
             ROUND(sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
           ELSE NULL
         END THEN 'TRUE'
    ELSE ''
  END AS check_1,

  CASE
    WHEN ROUND(wpi.prev_number_of_shares::NUMERIC / NULLIF(wpi.number_of_shares, 0), 4) =
         CASE
           WHEN sbu.corp_action IN ('Bonus', 'Rights') AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
             ROUND(1 + sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
           WHEN sbu.corp_action = 'Split' AND sbu.denominator != 0 THEN
             ROUND(sbu.numerator::NUMERIC / sbu.denominator, 4)
           ELSE NULL
         END THEN 'TRUE'
    ELSE ''
  END AS check_2,

  -- Month difference between to_date and ex_date
  DATE_PART('year', wpi.to_date) * 12 + DATE_PART('month', wpi.to_date) -
  (DATE_PART('year', sbu.ex_date) * 12 + DATE_PART('month', sbu.ex_date)) AS month_diff,

  -- Direction of change
  CASE
    WHEN wpi.shares_percent_increase > 0 THEN 'Increase'
    WHEN wpi.shares_percent_increase < 0 THEN 'Decrease'
    ELSE 'No Change'
  END AS change_direction

FROM with_percent_increase wpi
LEFT JOIN utils.split_bonus_utils sbu ON wpi.stock_symbol = sbu.stock_symbol
LEFT JOIN company_profiles cp ON wpi.stock_symbol = cp.stock_symbol
WHERE ABS(wpi.shares_percent_increase) > 5
ORDER BY wpi.shares_percent_increase DESC;
